title: docs: overhaul ROADMAP with audit-driven DX/UX improvement plan
body:
Full-repository audit across all 35 packages, 128 doc pages, 68 Storybook stories, and 200+ test files. Restructured roadmap priorities based on concrete findings from both developer experience and user experience perspectives.

### Audit findings

- **10 packages missing README**: auth, tenant, permissions, i18n, mobile, collaboration, plugin-ai, plugin-designer, plugin-workflow, plugin-report
- **20+ React hooks exported without JSDoc**
- **MIGRATION_GUIDE.md referenced in README but doesn't exist**
- **Console has hardcoded English strings** outside i18n (LoadingScreen, KeyboardShortcutsDialog)
- **Accessibility tests cover primitives only**, not assembled Console pages
- **No large-dataset performance baselines** for Grid/Kanban/Calendar
- **8 TODO/FIXME items** in CLI code (doctor.ts, dev.ts, check.ts)
- **Core errors lack error codes** and actionable fix suggestions

### ROADMAP changes

- **New section**: Full-Repository Audit with quantified scope table and key findings
- **Re-prioritized**: P1 DX → P2 UX → P3 Component Excellence → P4 Documentation (DX elevated from P3 to P1 based on gap severity)
- **P1 DX**: Zero-friction onboarding, JSDoc for all hooks/types, error code system (`OBJUI-xxx`), CLI polish, 10 package READMEs
- **P2 UX**: Console i18n completeness, architecture cleanup, WCAG AA on full pages, virtual scrolling for 10K+ records, responsive breakpoint testing
- **P3 Components**: Quality audit, field widget edge cases (RTL, emoji, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), test coverage 80→90%, Storybook 68→91+ stories
- **P4 Docs**: CRUD tutorial, plugin dev guide, architecture diagrams, Storybook deployment
- **Updated metrics**: Added measurement methods column, DX/UX success criteria checklists
- **Updated risks**: Added onboarding abandonment, i18n regression, accessibility regression with specific mitigations
